2608.16536.title: DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption
2608.16536.paper_summary: Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation (M-RAG) is increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks where malicious data are crafted to produce embeddings that align with benign entries in the vector space, deceiving retrieval and inducing harmful outputs. Existing defenses primarily operate at query time, relying on auxiliary detectors, similarity re-ranking, or feature-consistency checks. However, these approaches suffer from non-trivial inference overhead, generalize poorly to unseen attack strategies, and often assume specific attack distributions. To address this, we propose DSPrompt, a Dynamic Soft Prompt defense framework that directly reshapes the retriever's embedding semantics, without modifying the retrieval pipeline. It inserts few learnable soft prompts into each layer of the visual and textual encoders of a frozen retriever, utilizing a shallow-to-deep length schedule that is adaptive to the capacity in the model layers. These prompts are trained under a dynamic min-max scheme: an online multimodal attacker continually crafts hard adversarial documents against the current retriever, while the defender is updated to push such documents out of the top-k while preserving the ranking and diversity of benign evidence. Because the defended encoder can be pre-computed and indexed exactly as in standard dense retrieval, DSPrompt incurs no additional per-query optimization and introduces fewer than 1% additional parameters. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks and three representative poisoning attacks show that DSPrompt substantially reduces the attack success rate and poison retrieval rate while maintaining near-lossless retrieval utility and generation fidelity, consistently outperforming existing defense baselines at a fraction of their computational cost.
2608.16536.paper_summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成 (M-RAG) 越來越容易受到對抗攻擊，這些攻擊中，惡意數據被設計成產生與向量空間中良性條目對齊的嵌入，從而欺騙檢索並引發有害輸出。現有的防禦主要在查詢時運作，依賴輔助檢測器、相似性重新排序或特徵一致性檢查。然而，這些方法存在非平凡的推斷開銷，對未見攻擊策略的泛化能力差，並且通常假設特定的攻擊分佈。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 DSPrompt，一個動態軟提示防禦框架，該框架直接重塑檢索器的嵌入語義，而不修改檢索管道。它在凍結的檢索器的每一層視覺和文本編碼器中插入少量可學習的軟提示，利用適應於模型層容量的淺到深的長度計劃。這些提示在動態最小-最大方案下進行訓練：一個在線多模態攻擊者不斷針對當前檢索器製作困難的對抗文檔，而防禦者則被更新以將這些文檔推出前 k 名，同時保持良性證據的排名和多樣性。由於被防禦的編碼器可以像標準稠密檢索一樣進行預計算和索引，DSPrompt 不會產生額外的每查詢優化，並且引入的額外參數少於 1%。在四個基準和三個代表性毒害攻擊上的廣泛實驗表明，DSPrompt 顯著降低了攻擊成功率和毒害檢索率，同時保持近乎無損的檢索效用和生成保真度，並且在計算成本的很小一部分上持續超越現有的防禦基準。
